title: Ang Ebidensya
setup: May nagpakita ng ebidensya — ang supply log, ang resibo, ang larawan ng walang ginawa. Hindi na ito usap lang. Totoo na ito.
setup_en: Someone shows evidence — the supply log, the receipt, the photo of the empty site. This isn't talk anymore. It's real.

success.text: Hindi na matatanggi. Sumama ang mga Nag-aalalang Magulang.
success.text_en: It's undeniable. The Worried Parents join.

fail.text: Hinamon ka, pero nagsalita ka. Isang boses pa.
fail.text_en: You're questioned, but you spoke. One more voice.

choices.label: Isama ko ang mga echo ng ibang tao.
choices.label_en: I'll bring the echoes of others.

callback: Voice count +1/+2. Cautious Vendors may join.
